O.outcome_detail: correlation between Myers Mental Measure and Standard Revision of the Binet Scale

cells.note: The study reports an attributed correlation, not a treatment effect or superiority comparison; the phrase “is said to show” indicates the claim is hedged.

cells.note: The study compares measured correlations among tests rather than randomly assigned learning conditions.
